about: AP Psychology concept dependency map (docs/appsych-spec.md, docs/appsych-phase0.md): the 35 topics of the CED in order, the "Research skills you need" topics with the topic each comes before, and every concept with the topic that teaches it, the concepts it depends on and, for notation, the TeX patterns that use it. Our own words; no CED text. Checked by scripts/check-appsych-map.mjs.

ced.edition: Effective Fall 2025 with the October 2025 clarifications (5 units, 35 topics; the 2024-25 framework, not revised for 2026-27)
ced.note: Built from docs/appsych-ced-map.json, itself from docs/appsych-research/framework.md. Objectives for 2.7 to 5.5 from a third-party copy of the CED codes (docs/appsych-needs-author.md, ced-text).

everydayWords.about: Common words a student already roughly knows. They may be used in their everyday sense before the topic that teaches them; the technical terms of the same concept stay strict ("action potential", "operant conditioning", "major depressive disorder" are not used early).
